subject: Service differential credit proposal for ClearShift trial disruption
messages:
From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearshift.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearShift Support <support@clearshift.co>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Disruption during trial window — requests for remediation

Hi Priyom,

We hit a 45-minute period this morning where several of our demo endpoints saw 5–10s tail latency and a handful of 500s. This impacted a live product demo with three paying pilot customers and left us scrambling to switch to our fallback model.

We opened a support ticket but wanted to escalate to your team directly because this occurred during an active trial window and materially affected our conversion narrative. Can we get an account of what happened, logs for the window, and a proposal for how Redwood will make us whole? Ideally a token top-up and a one-week extension so we can finish the remainder of the trial without pressure.

I can share more traces if helpful — attaching the request payloads and the timestamps we captured.

Thanks,
Oliver
Founder & CTO, ClearShift
[Attachment: demo_request_traces.json]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Disruption during trial window — ClearShift — logs and ask

Folks — looping you in. ClearShift (CS-5471) flagged a 45-minute latency/500 window during a live demo. They want (a) incident log/causal note, (b) token top-up, (c) one-week trial extension.

Initial triage notes from Infra: suspected KV cache thrash on the serving pool during a regional burst; we failed over but the tail latency impacted demo traffic. Karthik, can you confirm whether this aligns with the autoscale/fallback timeline and whether any rate-limiter changes were applied that morning?

Marissa — this is stripe trial → pilot conversion; recommend credits + extension to preserve the deal momentum. Please propose a concrete compensation package we can offer that stays within our playbook for trial incidents.

I attached the customer traces Oliver sent.

-Priyom
Product Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: demo_request_traces.json]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearshift.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Disruption during trial window — remediation proposal

Hi Oliver — thanks again for flagging and for the traces. We investigated the region-specific serving pool and confirmed a cache eviction cascade tied to an abnormal prefix churn at 09:13 PST; autoscale kicked in but there was a short period of degraded tail latency and intermittent 500s while fallbacks warmed.

What we can offer today to make this right:
- 35,000 complimentary generation tokens applied to your ClearShift account (visible on your billing page within 2 business hours).
- One-week trial extension (new trial end: 2027-03-21) so you can complete the remaining pilot scenarios without the rushed window.
- Post-mortem note and the raw service traces for your team to review (attached).

If you prefer a different mix (tokens vs. a short-term increased rate cap) let me know — we can tailor to how you use the trial. I’ve copied Marissa to coordinate any billing workflows and Karthik for technical follow-up.

Attachments: latency_trace_20270307.zip, billing_snapshot_Mar-07.csv

Best,
Priyom Das
Product Sales, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearshift.co>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Disruption during trial window — remediation proposal

Hi Priyom — that sounds fair and appreciated. The 35k token top-up plus the week extension will let us re-run the interrupted demo and finish the remaining integration tests.

Two quick asks before you finalize: (1) can Marissa confirm the tokens will not count against our committed pilot quota (we want them purely as goodwill), and (2) can you include a one-paragraph incident summary we can share internally with the product team?

If those two points are covered we’ll mark this resolved on our side and proceed with the demo next week.

Thanks,
Oliver

On Tue, 9 Mar 2027 at 16:20:00 -07:00, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
> To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@clearshift.co>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
> Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
> Subject: Re: Disruption during trial window — remediation proposal
>
> Hi Oliver — confirmed: the 35,000 tokens are a one-time goodwill grant and will not be applied against any committed usage or quota for your pilot. I will push the credit to your account now and will follow up with an email confirmation once the billing snapshot and new trial end date are visible on your console.
>
> Brief incident summary for internal share (you can redistribute):
> "At 09:13 PST on 2027-03-07, a high prefix churn event in ClearShift demo traffic triggered a cache eviction cascade on the regional serving pool. While autoscaling initiated, fallback paths warmed with increased tail latency and transient 500s for ~45 minutes. No user data was exposed; impact was limited to request latency/errors during demonstration traffic. Redwood applied a goodwill token grant and a one-week trial extension to compensate. Technical follow-up: KV cache tuning and a targeted autoscale rule to prevent recurrence."
>
> I'll post the confirmation once the credits are applied.
>
> Cheers,
>Marissa
>Director, Customer Success
>Redwood Inference
